title: NIRARiskAssessment
description: Authoritative contract for explainable multimodal risk evaluation produced by AegisRiskEngine and RiskIntelligenceEngine.

risk_level.description: Multi-modal safety tier badge: LOW (Tier 1 Safe), MODERATE/HIGH (Tier 2 Alert), CRITICAL (Tier 3 Critical).

risk_score.description: Continuous risk probability score from 0.0 (safe baseline) to 1.0 (confirmed emergency).

confidence.description: Algorithmic confidence based on multi-sensor corroboration.

contributors.description: List of active risk multipliers elevating the risk score.

suppressed_factors.description: Potential hazards suppressed due to counter-evidence (e.g. resident confirmed safe verbally).

room_id.description: Room in which risk condition was localized.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of risk calculation.

action.description: Recommended algorithmic intervention (e.g. MONITOR_PASSIVE, INITIATE_VOICE_CHECK, IMMEDIATE_CAD_EMERGENCY_DISPATCH).

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier tying risk calculation back to triggering sensor evidence.
